environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) in us-east-1, running behind an Application Load Balancer with public-facing listener on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. The service runs as root in a Docker container with the host filesystem mounted at /var/data. No WAF rules attached to the ALB. Route53 public hosted zone resolves docs-api.example.com to the ALB. The container image is based on python:3.11-slim with uvicorn serving on port 8000.
